meta.description: Puntr's Self-Exclusion & Education Programme is in development. Find official South African self-exclusion guidance and confidential support.

title: Self-Exclusion & Support
subtitle: A safer path forward. We're building a dedicated programme to help South Africans understand self-exclusion, find the right official channels and access support.
statusBody: The Puntr Self-Exclusion & Education Programme is being developed with the intention of working alongside the appropriate regulators, support organisations and licensed operators.
notAnApplicationTitle: This is not an exclusion application
notAnApplicationBody: Puntr is not a bookmaker or a licensing authority. We cannot place, enforce, amend or lift a statutory self-exclusion order. Formal exclusion must be requested through the relevant licensed gambling operator or Provincial Licensing Authority.
supportTitle: You can get confidential support now
supportBody: The South African Responsible Gambling Foundation offers free, confidential counselling, assessment and referrals through its 24-hour helpline.
privacyBody: Please do not send Puntr identity documents, ID numbers, photographs or medical information. This temporary page does not collect applications or sensitive personal information.
disclaimer: If you feel at risk of harming yourself or someone else, contact local emergency services or go to the nearest emergency department.
